case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment caption on page 1.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment refers to 11 accused named in the final report and 11 arrested.

accused_gender.reason: The judgment never states the accused's gender; 'Mixed' is an inference.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: No accused occupation is stated for the accused as a group.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victims are the appellant and his brother, referred to with male pronouns.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: at whose instance ... the attack ... by 10-12 persons ... at the instance of one Anil Joshi, Cabinet Minister
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment does not describe the relationship as stranger; it only links the attack to Anil Joshi's instigation.

offence_category.reason: Charge under s.307 IPC, attempt to murder, is the core offence discussed.

statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the FIR sections listed on page 2.

weapon.reason: Swords, baseball bat, daatars and Gandassa are all mentioned on page 2.

evidence_type.reason: Complainant statement, medical report, weapon recovery and CCTV footage are all referenced.

confession.reason: Judgment is silent on confessions; 'None' asserts an absence the judgment does not expressly state.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Use of swords and daatars by 10-12 persons attacking victims in a car; no open declaration of intent recorded in this case
aggravating_circumstances.quote: 10-12 persons suddenly attacked the victims and they were armed with swords, baseball, etc.
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Deadly weapons supported, but open declaration and unarmed-victim points come from the quoted precedent, not this case.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Judge framed charges under the listed sections, including s.307, per page 3.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court deleted the s.307 charge while maintaining other charges.

final_outcome.correct_value: Not stated (no conviction; appeal allowed and accused to be tried under s.307 IPC)
final_outcome.quote: the accused persons shall also be tried for the offence under Section 307 IPC
final_outcome.reason: No conviction is recorded; the Supreme Court only restored the charge and directed trial.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Not stated; ingredients of s.307 IPC held prima facie made out at charge stage
offence_finally_established.quote: The above facts would indicate that the ingredients of Section 307 IPC are made out.
offence_finally_established.reason: Court only found ingredients prima facie at framing of charge; no offence was finally established.

imprisonment_type.quote: the accused persons shall also be tried for the offence under Section 307 IPC
imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence was imposed; the judgment only directs trial, so fixed_term is unsupported.

imprisonment_years.reason: No imprisonment term is stated, so null is appropriate.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is stated, so null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Attack by 10-12 armed persons on victims in a car; car glass smashed; grievous sharp-edged injuries; medical report, weapon recovery and CCTV examined; prosecution case on intent to kill.
neutral_facts.quote: Open announcement by the accused and others that the appellant would not be alive
neutral_facts.reason: Attackers' open statements of intent come from the quoted precedent, not this case's facts; the rest is accurate and outcome-neutral.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the punishment prescribed under s.307 IPC.

attempt_completion.reason: The offence is an attempt to murder under s.307 IPC.

physical_harm.reason: Grievous injuries by sharp-edged weapons and simple injuries are described on pages 2 and 4.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charged with multiple IPC offences including s.307; High Court deleted s.307 charge; Supreme Court restored it
number_of_offences.quote: deleted the charge framed under Section 307 IPC as unsustainable while maintaining the charge in respect of other offences
number_of_offences.reason: Describes the Supreme Court outcome vaguely and omits that the High Court had deleted the s.307 charge.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Damage to car glass (front, back and driving side glass smashed); s.427 IPC charged
financial_property_loss.quote: smashed the front, backside and driving side glass of the car
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment describes property damage to the car and a s.427 charge, so 'Not applicable' is inaccurate.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not stated (motive to teach a lesson is noted; no premeditation finding is made)
premeditation_planning.quote: to punish the appellant/ teach him a lesson for instituting four cases against the said Anil Joshi
premeditation_planning.reason: The court made no premeditation finding; the open-declaration basis comes from the quoted precedent.

motive.reason: Motive to punish the appellant for instituting four cases against Anil Joshi is stated.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Complainant's statement and medical report (sharp-edged grievous injuries) relied on at charge stage; no evidence of accused's intent to kill in this case was accepted
key_evidence_accepted.quote: Having regard to the aforesaid statement of the persons recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and the medical report
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court relied on statements and medical report prima facie only; the expressed intent to kill is from the precedent.

witness_credibility.reason: The court made no credibility assessment of witnesses; it only assessed charge-stage material.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused skipped away from the spot in their cars with their weapons after people gathered
post_offence_conduct.quote: accused alongwith their respective weapons skipped away from the spot on their cars
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment does describe the accused fleeing the scene with weapons, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence/FIR date: 10.05.2014 (para 5 says 10.05.2004); High Court order: 28.08.2015; Supreme Court decision: April 13, 2017; no trial judgment date given
trial_duration.reason: Offence date conflicts with FIR date; 28.08.2015 is the High Court order, not a trial judgment.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellant (complainant) counsel: Manu Sharma, Ms. Ridhima Mandhar, M. Shoeb Alam, Ms. Fauzia Shakil, Ujjwal Singh, Mojahid Karim Khan; Respondents' counsel: Jitendra Mohan Sharma, Sr. Adv., Ajit Sharma, Sandeep Singh, Ms. Shweta Jain Pahlad Singh Sharma
legal_representation.quote: Advs. for the Appellant. Jitendra Mohan Sharma, Sr. Adv., Ajit Sharma, Sandeep Singh, Ms. Shweta Jain Pahlad Singh Sharma, Advs. for the Respondents.
legal_representation.reason: First group represents the appellant complainant, not the accused; labels are reversed.

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR registered, charge sheet filed, charges framed; trial pending
investigation_status.quote: The Sessions Judge framed charges under the aforesaid provisions, including Section 307 IPC.
investigation_status.reason: Trial is not completed; the accused are yet to be tried under s.307 IPC.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: High Court erred in deleting the s.307 IPC charge at the framing-of-charge stage
procedural_irregularity.quote: we fail to understand as to how the High Court could come to the conclusion, at the stage of framing of the charge itself
procedural_irregularity.reason: Supreme Court found the High Court's approach clearly unsustainable, which is a procedural error.

appeal_history.reason: Trial court framing, High Court deletion and Supreme Court allowance of appeal match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.reason: Appellant's ground that s.307 charge was rightly framed and facts show grievous attack with deadly weapons is reflected.

defence_argument.reason: Defence argued medical evidence did not support s.307 and intention to kill was missing, per page 2.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Intention is a question of fact and injuries need not be fatal, as stated on pages 4 and 5.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Anjani Kumar Chaudhary v. State of Bihar (2014) 12 SCC 286 is cited on pages 1 and 4.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing is addressed, so the value 'Not applicable' is acceptable.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court identifies no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court does not weigh aggravating factors for sentence.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Appeal allowed; High Court order quashed; accused to be tried for offence under s.307 IPC
other_sentence_order.quote: the order of the High Court is hereby quashed and set aside. As a consequence, the accused persons shall also be tried for the offence under Section 307 IPC
other_sentence_order.reason: The Supreme Court did direct trial under s.307, so 'None' is contradicted.
